{{Top|leg}}
'''Chronamite''' was a poisonous mineral from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. It could be processed into a strong alloy for use in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and vehicle construction.<ref name="AJ12">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref> It could also be used as a poison.<ref name="SWG:BSSC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Black Sun Stealing Chronamite}} on Corellia</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Corellian Chemical Corporation/Legends|Corellian Chemical Corporation]] owned a large stock of such a mineral.<ref name="SWG:BSSC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the company recruited an independent strike team to destroy a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] base on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] from where the criminals intended to steal the company's stocks of chronamite.<ref name="SWG:BSSC" />
